questions.question: What is the sum of all two-digit numbers divisible by both 4 and 6?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Divisible by 4 and 6 ⇒ LCM = 12

Two-digit multiples: 12, 24, 36, ... , 96

Total terms = 96 ÷ 12 = 8

Sum = 12 × (1 + 2 + ... + 8) = 12 × 36

**∴ Answer = 432**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** 

**Given:**

Two-digit numbers divisible by both 4 and 6

**Formula used:**

LCM method and AP sum = n × (first + last) ÷ 2

 
• 12 24 36 48 60 ... Last = 96 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Numbers divisible by both 4 and 6 ⇒ LCM = 12

⇒ Series: 12, 24, 36, ... , 96 (AP)

⇒ n = 96 ÷ 12 = 8

⇒ Sum = 8 × (12 + 96) ÷ 2

⇒ = 8 × 108 ÷ 2 = 4 × 108 = 432

**∴ The correct answer is 432.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM Concept

Numbers divisible by multiple numbers ⇒ use LCM. Example: divisible by 4 and 6 ⇒ LCM = 12.

Arithmetic Progression (AP)

Sequence with constant difference. Here d = 12. Terms: a, a+d, a+2d...

Sum of AP

Sum = n × (first + last) ÷ 2

Number of Terms

n = last term ÷ common difference when series starts from first multiple.

questions.question: What is the value of (0.64 ÷ 4) ÷ (1.28 - 0.16) = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

0.64 ÷ 4 = 0.16

Denominator: 1.28 − 0.16 = 1.12

So expression = 0.16 ÷ 1.12

Convert to fraction ⇒ 16 ÷ 112 = 1 ÷ 7

**∴ Answer = 1 ÷ 7**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(0.64 ÷ 4) ÷ (1.28 − 0.16)

**Formula used:**

Convert decimals into fractions and simplify

 0.64 ÷ 4 1.28 − 0.16 ÷ 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 0.64 ÷ 4 = 0.16

⇒ 1.28 − 0.16 = 1.12

⇒ Expression = 0.16 ÷ 1.12

⇒ Convert to fraction: 16 ÷ 112

⇒ Simplify = 1 ÷ 7

**∴ The correct answer is 1 ÷ 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Decimal to Fraction

0.16 = 16 ÷ 100, 1.12 = 112 ÷ 100. Cancelling gives simpler ratio.

Division of Decimals

a ÷ b = (a × 100) ÷ (b × 100) to remove decimals easily.

Simplification Rule

Always reduce numerator and denominator by common factors.

BODMAS Rule

Solve brackets first, then division and subtraction step by step.

questions.question: T and U start a business. T invests ₹40,000. After 3 months, U joins with ₹60,000. After 3 more months, T doubles his capital. If the business runs for 12 months, find the profit ratio of T to U.
questions.solution:

Profit ∝ Capital × Time

T: 40000×3 + 40000×3 + 80000×6 = 120000 + 120000 + 480000 = 720000

U: 60000×9 = 540000

Ratio = 720000 : 540000

**∴ Answer = 4 : 3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

T invests ₹40000 initially

After 3 months, U invests ₹60000

After next 3 months, T doubles capital to ₹80000

Total time = 12 months

**Formula used:**

Profit ∝ Capital × Time

 T: 40k (0-3) T: 40k (3-6) T: 80k (6-12) U: 60k (3-12) 

**Calculations:**

⇒ T: 40000×3 = 120000

⇒ T: 40000×3 = 120000

⇒ T: 80000×6 = 480000

⇒ Total T = 720000

⇒ U: 60000×9 = 540000

⇒ Ratio = 720000 : 540000

⇒ Divide by 180000 ⇒ 4 : 3

**∴ The correct answer is 4 : 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Capital-Time Rule

Profit share = Capital × Time. Always break into intervals when capital changes.

Joining Midway

If a partner joins later, calculate time from joining to end.

Changing Capital

When capital changes, treat each period separately.

Ratio Simplification

Divide both terms by highest common factor to get simplest ratio.

questions.question: Which of the following is the effective annual rate of interest corresponding to a compound interest rate of 9% per annum compounded half-yearly?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Half-yearly rate = 9% ÷ 2 = 4.5%

Effective rate = (1 + 4.5/100)² − 1

= (1.045)² − 1 = 1.092025 − 1

**∴ Answer = 9.20%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Nominal rate = 9% per annum

Compounded half-yearly ⇒ 2 times in a year

**Formula used:**

Effective Rate = (1 + r/2 ÷ 100)² − 1

 
• 0 1 yr +4.5% +4.5% 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Half-yearly rate = 9 ÷ 2 = 4.5%

⇒ Effective Rate = (1 + 4.5/100)² − 1

⇒ = (1.045)² − 1

⇒ = 1.092025 − 1

⇒ = 0.092025 = 9.20%

**∴ The correct answer is 9.20%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Annual Rate

Effective rate = (1 + r/n)ⁿ − 1, where n = number of compounding periods.

Half-Yearly Compounding

Rate is divided by 2 and time is multiplied by 2.

Quarterly Compounding

Rate is divided by 4 and applied 4 times in a year.

SI vs CI Growth

CI gives higher return than SI due to compounding effect.

questions.question: By selling 5 chairs for ₹1200, a carpenter gains the cost price of 2 chairs. The profit percent is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit = CP of 2 chairs on selling 5 chairs

So CP : Profit = 5 : 2

Profit% = (2 ÷ 5) × 100

**∴ Answer = 40%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling price of 5 chairs = 1200

Profit = cost price of 2 chairs

**Formula used:**

Profit% = (Profit ÷ Cost Price) × 100

 CP (5 chairs) Profit = CP of 2 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let CP of 1 chair = x

⇒ CP of 5 chairs = 5x

⇒ Profit = 2x

⇒ Profit% = (2x ÷ 5x) × 100 = 40%

**∴ The correct answer is 40%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Method in Profit

If profit is given in terms of CP units, directly form ratio CP : Profit.

Basic Profit Formula

Profit% = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100.

Selling Price Relation

SP = CP + Profit.

Unitary Trick

Assume 1 unit CP to quickly form ratios and avoid heavy calculation.

questions.question: A and B together can finish a work in 18 days, B and C in 24 days, and C and A in 36 days. In how many days can B alone complete the work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use formula: B = (AB + BC − CA) ÷ 2

AB = 1/18, BC = 1/24, CA = 1/36

B = (1/18 + 1/24 − 1/36) ÷ 2

= (4 + 3 − 2)/72 ÷ 2 = 5/72 ÷ 2 = 5/144

Time = 144 ÷ 5

**∴ Answer = 28.8 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A + B = 18 days

B + C = 24 days

C + A = 36 days

**Formula used:**

Total Work = LCM of 18, 24, 36 = 72

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Days

(A+B) + (B+C) − (C+A) = 4 + 3 − 2 = 5 = 2B

B efficiency = 5 ÷ 2 = 2.5

**Calculations:**

⇒ B's work per day = 2.5 units

⇒ Time taken = 72 ÷ 2.5

⇒ = 28.8 days

**∴ The correct answer is 28.8 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Individual Efficiency Formula

B = (AB + BC − CA) ÷ 2 when efficiencies are given.

LCM Method

Take LCM as total work to simplify efficiency calculations.

Efficiency Concept

Efficiency = Work per day, Time = Total Work ÷ Efficiency.

Work Combination Trick

(AB + BC − CA) eliminates A and C to isolate B.

questions.question: Two types of tea are mixed. The first type costs ₹18 per kg and the second type costs ₹20 per kg. In what ratio should these be mixed so that by selling the mixture at ₹21 per kg, a profit of 10% is gained?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

SP = ₹21, Profit = 10% ⇒ CP = 21 ÷ 1.1 = ₹210/11 ≈ ₹19.09.

Using Alligation: (Type 2 CP − Mean CP) : (Mean CP − Type 1 CP)

(20 − 210/11) : (210/11 − 18) = (220 − 210)/11 : (210 − 198)/11

Ratio = 10 : 12 = 5 : 6.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 : 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

CP₁ = ₹18/kg, CP₂ = ₹20/kg, SP of mixture = ₹21/kg, Profit = 10%.

**Formula Used:**

CP = [SP × 100] ÷ [100 + Profit%]; Alligation Rule.

 Tea 1 (CP) Tea 2 (CP) 18 20 210/11 
• 
• Ratio Part 1: 10/11 Ratio Part 2: 12/11 

 

⇒ CP of mixture = (21 × 100) ÷ (100 + 10) = 2100 ÷ 110 = ₹210/11 per kg.

Apply Alligation: 

⇒ Quantity of Tea 1 ÷ Quantity of Tea 2 = (CP₂ − Mean CP) ÷ (Mean CP − CP₁)

⇒ Ratio = [20 − (210/11)] ÷ [(210/11) − 18]

⇒ Ratio = [(220 − 210)/11] ÷ [(210 − 198)/11]

⇒ Ratio = 10/11 ÷ 12/11 = 10 : 12 = 5 : 6.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 : 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alligation Rule Consistency

When using the alligation cross, all three values (Cheaper, Dearer, and Mean) must be in the same unit—either all CP or all SP.

Mixture with Profit

If SP and Profit% are given for a mixture, always convert SP to CP before applying the ratio formula.

Weighted Average

The mean price can also be found using (n₁c₁ + n₂c₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is quantity and c is cost per unit.

questions.question: Given: (p)/(a) + (q)/(b) + (r)/(c) = 1 and (a)/(p) + (b)/(q) + (c)/(r) = 0, where p, q, r and a, b, c are non-zero, then the value of (p²)/(a²) + (q²)/(b²) + (r²)/(c²)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let x = p/a, y = q/b, z = r/c

Given: x + y + z = 1 and 1/x + 1/y + 1/z = 0

(xy + yz + zx) ÷ xyz = 0 ⇒ xy + yz + zx = 0

(x + y + z)² = x² + y² + z² + 2(xy + yz + zx)

1 = x² + y² + z²

**∴ Answer = 1**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

p/a + q/b + r/c = 1

a/p + b/q + c/r = 0

**Formula used:**

(x + y + z)² = x² + y² + z² + 2(xy + yz + zx)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let x = p/a, y = q/b, z = r/c

⇒ x + y + z = 1

⇒ 1/x + 1/y + 1/z = 0 ⇒ (xy + yz + zx) ÷ xyz = 0

⇒ xy + yz + zx = 0

⇒ (x + y + z)² = x² + y² + z² + 2(xy + yz + zx)

⇒ 1 = x² + y² + z²

⇒ Required = (p²/a²) + (q²/b²) + (r²/c²) = x² + y² + z²

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Substitution Trick

Replace ratios like p/a with variables to simplify expressions.

Symmetric Identity

(x + y + z)² identity helps connect sums and squares.

Reciprocal Condition

1/x + 1/y + 1/z = 0 ⇒ xy + yz + zx = 0.

Exam Shortcut

Directly jump to identity once xy + yz + zx = 0 is obtained.

questions.question: An urn initially contains 3 red balls and 2 blue balls. You draw two balls without replacement. If both balls are the same color, you stop. If they are different colors, you put both balls back into the urn, add one additional red ball to the urn, and then draw two more balls. What is the probability that you do not stop on the first draw, but you stop on the second draw?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

First draw different = (3×2 + 2×3) ÷ (5×4) = 12/20 = 3/5

Add 1 red → new balls = 4R, 2B (total 6)

Second draw same color = [4C2 + 2C2] ÷ 6C2 = (6 + 1)/15 = 7/15

Required probability = 3/5 × 7/15

= 21/75 = 7/25

**∴ Answer = 7/25**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial: 3 red, 2 blue

Condition: Stop if same color, else add 1 red and repeat

**Formula used:**

Probability = Favorable outcomes ÷ Total outcomes

**Calculations:**

⇒ P(different first) = (3×2 + 2×3) ÷ (5×4) = 12 ÷ 20 = 3/5

⇒ New urn: 4 red, 2 blue → total = 6

⇒ P(same second) = [4C2 + 2C2] ÷ 6C2 = (6 + 1) ÷ 15 = 7/15

⇒ Required probability = 3/5 × 7/15 = 21/75 = 7/25

**∴ The correct answer is 7/25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Without Replacement

Probabilities change after each draw since total balls reduce

Combination Formula

nC2 = n(n−1)/2 used for selecting 2 items

Sequential Probability

Multiply probabilities of successive independent steps

Same Color Cases

Same color = both red or both blue → add both probabilities

questions.question: An aircraft is flying at a steady altitude of 1000 meters. From a point on the ground, the angle of elevation of the airplane changes from 60° to 45° in 20 seconds as it flies directly away from the observer. What is the approximate speed of the airplane?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use tanθ = height ÷ distance

At 60°: distance = 1000 ÷ √3 ≈ 577 m

At 45°: distance = 1000 m

Distance travelled = 1000 − 577 = 423 m

Speed = 423 ÷ 20 ≈ 21.1 m/s

**∴ Answer ≈ 21.1**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height = 1000 m

Angles = 60°, 45°

Time = 20 sec

**Formula used:**

tanθ = Height ÷ Base

**Calculations:**

⇒ For 60°: tan60 = 1000 ÷ d₁ ⇒ √3 = 1000 ÷ d₁

⇒ d₁ = 1000 ÷ √3 ≈ 577 m

⇒ For 45°: tan45 = 1000 ÷ d₂ ⇒ 1 = 1000 ÷ d₂

⇒ d₂ = 1000 m

⇒ Distance travelled = 1000 − 577 = 423 m

⇒ Speed = 423 ÷ 20 ≈ 21.1 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is ≈ 21.1 m/s**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometry Relation

tanθ = opposite ÷ adjacent → used for height-distance problems

Standard Values

tan45° = 1, tan60° = √3

Horizontal Motion

Aircraft moves horizontally → height remains constant

Speed Formula

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

questions.question:
A botanist was interested in the average height and standard deviation of a new plant variety. The following data are the heights for a sample of n=10 plants. The average height is 11.00 cm, rounded to two places. Find the sample standard deviation, rounded to two decimal places.

 

 
 

 9.5
 12
 11.5
 10.5
 13
 10
 11.5
 12
 10.5
 9.5
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Mean = 11

Deviations: −1.5, 1, 0.5, −0.5, 2, −1, 0.5, 1, −0.5, −1.5

Squares sum = 12.5

Sample variance = 12.5 ÷ 9 = 1.39

SD = √1.39 ≈ 1.18

**∴ Answer = 1.18**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Data: 9.5, 12, 11.5, 10.5, 13, 10, 11.5, 12, 10.5, 9.5

n = 10, Mean = 11

**Formula used:**

Sample SD = √[Σ(x − mean)² ÷ (n − 1)]

**Calculations:**

⇒ Deviations: (x − 11) = −1.5, 1, 0.5, −0.5, 2, −1, 0.5, 1, −0.5, −1.5

⇒ Squares = 2.25 + 1 + 0.25 + 0.25 + 4 + 1 + 0.25 + 1 + 0.25 + 2.25 = 12.5

⇒ Variance = 12.5 ÷ 9 = 1.39

⇒ Standard deviation = √1.39 ≈ 1.18

**∴ The correct answer is 1.18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sample vs Population

Sample SD uses (n − 1) to reduce bias

Shortcut Formula

Variance = (Σx² ÷ n) − (mean)²

Standard Deviation Meaning

Measures spread of data around mean

Deviation Method

Taking deviations from mean simplifies calculations

questions.question: A sphere having a radius R is melted and recast into a hemisphere and a cylinder. The hemisphere and cylinder have equal radii and heights. If the height of the cylinder is equal to its radius r, find the ratio R:r.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume conserved: Sphere = Hemisphere + Cylinder

Sphere = 4/3 πR³

Hemisphere = 2/3 πr³, Cylinder = πr³ (since h = r)

Total = 2/3 πr³ + πr³ = 5/3 πr³

4/3 πR³ = 5/3 πr³ ⇒ R³ = 5/4 r³

**∴ Answer = R : r = ∛5 : ∛4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of sphere = R

Hemisphere and cylinder have radius = r

Height of cylinder = r

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = 4/3 πR³

Volume of hemisphere = 2/3 πr³

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

 Sphere (R) 
 
• Hemisphere (r) Cylinder (r, h=r) 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of sphere = 4/3 πR³

⇒ Volume of hemisphere = 2/3 πr³

⇒ Volume of cylinder = πr² × r = πr³

⇒ Total new volume = 2/3 πr³ + πr³ = 5/3 πr³

questions.question: A right prism has a rectangular base with dimensions 6 cm and 10 cm. The height of the prism is 18 cm. Find the total surface area of the prism.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Base = rectangle → 6 × 10 = 60

Perimeter = 2(6 + 10) = 32

Lateral area = Perimeter × height = 32 × 18 = 576

Total surface area = 576 + 2 × 60 = 576 + 120

**∴ Answer = 696 cm²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length = 10 cm, Breadth = 6 cm, Height = 18 cm

**Formula used:**

Total Surface Area = Lateral Surface Area + 2 × Base Area

Lateral Surface Area = Perimeter of base × Height

**Calculations:**

⇒ Base area = 6 × 10 = 60

⇒ Perimeter = 2(6 + 10) = 32

⇒ Lateral surface area = 32 × 18 = 576

⇒ Total surface area = 576 + 2 × 60 = 576 + 120 = 696

**∴ The correct answer is 696 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Prism Surface Area

Total Surface Area = Lateral Surface Area + 2 × Base Area

Lateral Surface Area

LSA = Perimeter of base × Height

Volume of Prism

Volume = Base Area × Height

Cuboid Special Case

If base is rectangle, prism behaves like cuboid → TSA = 2(lb + bh + hl)

questions.question: A rectangular garden 20 m × 14 m has four full circular flowerbeds of radius 2 m placed within it. What is the area left for grass?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of rectangle = 20 × 14 = 280

Area of 1 circle = π × 2² = 4π

4 circles → total = 16π

Take π = 22/7 → 16π = 352/7 ≈ 50.29

Area left = 280 − 50.29 ≈ 229.71

**∴ Answer ≈ 229.7 m²**

Area of circle = πr²

 20 m 14 m

⇒ Area of rectangle = 20 × 14 = 280 m²

⇒ Area of 1 circle = π × 2² = 4π

⇒ Area of 4 circles = 16π

⇒ Using π = 22/7 → 16π = 352/7 ≈ 50.29

questions.question: Two complementary angles differ by 36°. What are the angles?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Complementary angles sum = 90°

Let angles = (90 + 36)/2 and (90 − 36)/2

= 126/2 and 54/2

= 63° and 27°

**∴ Answer = 63°, 27°**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of angles = 90°, Difference = 36°

**Formula used:**

If sum = S and difference = D:

Angles = (S + D)/2 and (S − D)/2

**Calculations:**

⇒ Angle 1 = (90 + 36) ÷ 2 = 126 ÷ 2 = 63°

⇒ Angle 2 = (90 − 36) ÷ 2 = 54 ÷ 2 = 27°

**∴ The correct answer is 63° and 27°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Complementary Angles

Two angles whose sum is 90°

Supplementary Angles

Two angles whose sum is 180°

Sum-Difference Trick

Angles = (Sum ± Difference) ÷ 2

Equal Angles Case

If no difference given, both angles = Sum ÷ 2

questions.question:
The data given below shows the rainfall (in cm) recorded in a city on 5 different days.

Rainfall: 5, 6, 8, 10, 11

Find the sample variance of the given data.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Mean = (5 + 6 + 8 + 10 + 11) ÷ 5 = 40 ÷ 5 = 8

Deviations: −3, −2, 0, 2, 3

Squares: 9, 4, 0, 4, 9 → Sum = 26

Sample variance = 26 ÷ (5 − 1) = 26 ÷ 4

**∴ Answer = 6.5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Data = 5, 6, 8, 10, 11

**Formula used:**

Sample variance = Σ(x − mean)² ÷ (n − 1)

 
• 5 6 8 10 11 Mean = 8 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Mean = 40 ÷ 5 = 8

⇒ (x − mean) = −3, −2, 0, 2, 3

⇒ Squares = 9 + 4 + 0 + 4 + 9 = 26

⇒ Sample variance = 26 ÷ (5 − 1) = 26 ÷ 4 = 6.5

**∴ The correct answer is 6.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Population vs Sample Variance

Sample variance uses (n − 1), population variance uses n

Shortcut for Variance

Variance = (Σx² ÷ n) − (mean)²

Standard Deviation

SD = √(variance)

Deviation Method

Take deviations from mean to simplify calculations

questions.question: If sin A - cos A = 1/3 and A in (0, pi/2) , then what is sin 2A?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: (sinA − cosA)² = 1 − 2sinAcosA

(1/3)² = 1 − 2sinAcosA

1/9 = 1 − 2sinAcosA

2sinAcosA = 8/9

sin2A = 2sinAcosA = 8/9

**∴ Answer = 8/9**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

sinA − cosA = 1/3, A ∈ (0, π/2)

**Formula used:**

(sinA − cosA)² = sin²A + cos²A − 2sinAcosA

sin²A + cos²A = 1

sin2A = 2sinAcosA

**Calculations:**

⇒ (sinA − cosA)² = (1/3)² = 1/9

⇒ 1 − 2sinAcosA = 1/9

⇒ 2sinAcosA = 1 − 1/9 = 8/9

⇒ sin2A = 2sinAcosA = 8/9

**∴ The correct answer is 8/9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Important Identity

sin²A + cos²A = 1

Double Angle Formula

sin2A = 2sinAcosA

Square Trick

(a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab

Angle Range

A in first quadrant → sinA, cosA both positive
